name: transit
description: Transit: Subway maps of your data.

scripts.test: node src/request-transit/scripts/test-normalize.mjs && node src/request-transit/scripts/test-contracts.mjs && node core/test-vocab.mjs && node src/ci-transit/scripts/test-gh.mjs && node src/agent-transit/scripts/test-agent.mjs && node scripts/build-skills.mjs --check && node scripts/test-skill-copy.mjs
scripts.check: npm test && npm run verify && npm run verify:ci && npm run verify:agent && npm run test:ui
scripts.build: node core/build.mjs src/request-transit/samples/otel-demo-checkout.otlp.json --out out/otel/transit.html --title "Checkout: one order through the Astronomy Shop" --subtitle "OpenTelemetry Demo service names  ·  SYNTHETIC hand-built trace in OTLP JSON shape"
scripts.build:dd: node core/build.mjs src/request-transit/samples/datadog-sample.json --out out/dd/transit.html --title "Order create, from a Datadog-shaped trace" --subtitle "Fictional services  ·  SYNTHETIC hand-made sample in Datadog span JSON shape"
scripts.render: node core/render.mjs src/request-transit/samples/otel-demo-checkout.otlp.json --name otel --title "Checkout: one order through the Astronomy Shop" --subtitle "OpenTelemetry Demo service names  ·  SYNTHETIC hand-built trace in OTLP JSON shape"
scripts.render:dd: node core/render.mjs src/request-transit/samples/datadog-sample.json --name dd --title "Order create, from a Datadog-shaped trace" --subtitle "Fictional services  ·  SYNTHETIC hand-made sample in Datadog span JSON shape"

scripts.test:ui: npm run -s build && npm run -s index:example && npm run -s build:contracts && node src/request-transit/scripts/test-ui.mjs out/otel/transit.html --shot out/ui/panel-open.png --contracts-page out/otel-contracts/transit.html --contracts-shot out/ui/panel-contracts.png --scroll-shots out/ui && node core/test-network.mjs && npm run -s build:ci && node src/ci-transit/scripts/test-ui-ci.mjs out/ci/transit.html
